detail.title: Synthesis of Popperian Epistemology Regarding Value-Based Inquiry
detail.summary: This research journal entry synthesizes durable evidence regarding the application of Popperian falsification principles to human values. We observe that while empirical methods effectively challenge specific hypotheses, applying them directly to foundational human values—such as purpose or fairness—often encounters category errors where normative claims are treated as falsifiable descriptive propositions. We conclude that scientific inquiry serves as a necessary but insufficient framework for value-based research, primarily functioning to constrain rather than define the normative domain.
